(a) The powerplant and auxiliary power unit cooling provisions must maintain the temperatures of :
  (1) powerplant components (2) engine fluids (3) auxiliary power unit components and fluids within the limits established for those components, and, (4) fluids under the most adverse ground, waterand flight operations to the maximum altitude and maximum ambient atmospheric temperature conditions for which approval is requested, and after normal engine and auxiliary power unit shutdown.
(b) In the event of failure of the normal mode of cooling, an alternative method of cooling shall be provided for safety of flight critical components, if required.
(c) Pressurized components of cooling systems must have appropriate proof and burst testing.

The powerplant and auxiliary power unit cooling provisions must maintain the temperatures of:
(a) powerplant components.
(b) engine fluids.
(c) auxiliary power unit components and fluids within the limits established for those components, and fluids.
